# GSAP 3.13.0

This directory vendors the official GSAP and ScrollTrigger browser distributions from the gsap@3.13.0 npm package, obtained through jsDelivr. Their original copyright and license notices remain in the JavaScript headers.

- Copyright (c) 2025, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
- Licensing: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.13.0
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0

The application loads these local copies rather than contacting a CDN at runtime.
